REAL HORSE RESCUES is an original series created and hosted by award-winning producer Susan Kayne on ABC-WTEN Every Saturday at 6:00AM. Its mission is to raise public awareness of equine welfare concerns, and bring visibility to the compassionate work of equine sanctuaries, rescues, and adoption organizations. Guests range from boots-on-the-ground rescuers, to legislators, to celebrities, to young advocates, and of course many four-legged stars.

RHR focuses on rescue success stories to encourage viewers to participate directly with equine organizations in their communities to give horses a second chance. Real Horse Rescues is a program of the Unbridled Thoroughbred Foundation, a 501 c (3) not-for-profit educational organization guided by the belief that every equine life deserves humane treatment, compassion, respect, and protection from harm.
